items.name: hitl-utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: Tailwind classname merge helper used by every HITL Kit primitive.

items.name: hitl-types
items.title: HITL UI types
items.description: The props every decision surface shares (busy, error, help, allowAbstain, allowUndo, autoFocus) and the interrupt card's local state. Event and action types come from @hitl-kit/core.

items.name: hitl-shared
items.title: Shared decision pieces
items.description: The card frame, decision bar, resolved line, inline error, help line and chip that every decision surface is built from. One vocabulary, one set of button styles.

items.name: hitl-subagent-meta
items.title: Subagent status metadata
items.description: Shared icon, color and plain label for the six agent execution states (idle, running, completed, error, skipped, cancelled).

items.name: hitl-ai-levels
items.title: AI generation levels
items.description: The five-point AI-generation ordinal and its accent progression, shared by every scale variant so a level cannot mean one thing in the slider and another in the badge.

items.name: hitl-fixtures
items.title: Demo events
items.description: Valid core events for the decision surfaces, for demos and tests. Spread one onto its primitive or feed it to HitlEventRenderer.

items.name: hitl-card
items.title: Interrupt Card
items.description: In-thread approval boundary for agent actions. Three semantic variants (search, review, write). Idle, expanded, confirmed and dismissed, and every resolution can be undone.

items.name: subagent-status-card
items.title: Subagent Status Card
items.description: Single-row agent status with icon, label, detail, and state in words. Use to wrap any in-progress agentic task.

items.name: mini-trace
items.title: MiniTrace
items.description: Collapsible step-by-step renderer for agent reasoning. Thought, action, result. Makes supporting facts visible per §3.3 of the paper.

items.name: ai-generation-scale
items.title: AI Generation Scale
items.description: Five-segment ordinal scale indicating AI involvement in a piece of work. Embodies the scaffolding and expertise-matching principle from Dhillon et al. (2024).

items.name: ai-generation-slider
items.title: AI Generation Slider
items.description: The compact drag form of the AI generation scale. One header row and one track, no wrapping at 320px. Pointer drag snaps to five stops; arrow keys step and Home/End jump. Full slider ARIA.

items.name: ai-generation-meter
items.title: AI Generation Meter
items.description: At-a-glance, read-only provenance for a list row or a header. Five thin segments filled to the current level plus the level name, as a single role=img element with no focusable children.

items.name: ai-generation-badge
items.title: AI Generation Badge
items.description: The densest form of the AI generation scale: one pill with a five-dot micro-indicator and the level name. Static by default; given onAction it grows stepper buttons with 24px hit areas.

items.name: context-chips
items.title: Context Chips
items.description: Pill chips representing context attached to an agent run. Notes, files, URLs. Removable with overflow truncation.

items.name: qa-flow
items.title: QA Flow
items.description: Multi-question approval card. Single-choice, multi-select, and freeform text. Submits to a resolved line that keeps the answers visible and can be reopened.

items.name: writing-agent
items.title: Writing Agent
items.description: Compound widget for a draft-in-progress document. Title, target section, word range, evidence notes, and six status states.

items.name: research-agent
items.title: Research Agent
items.description: Three-mode config surface for a long-running research task. Create, follow-up, read URL.

items.name: batch-queue
items.title: Batch Approval Queue
items.description: Sequential approve and reject flow across mixed agent items. Auto-advances, can step back one item, and resolves to a summary state.

items.name: search-result-card
items.title: Search Result Card
items.description: Ranked search result card with rank badge, metadata, snippet, and relevance bar.

items.name: approve-reject-row
items.title: Approve / Reject Row
items.description: The canonical decision row. Approve, reject, or can't tell; pending, approved, rejected, abstained; undo back to pending.

items.name: shared-primitives
items.title: Shared Primitives
items.description: The atomic palette. Accent swatches, the four approval badges, and the decision row that sets them.

items.name: diff-result
items.title: Diff Result
items.description: Before/after diff card for proposed text or code edits. Per-hunk red/green strips; apply, keep original, or can't tell; undo. The primitive for any in-place edit the human should approve before it lands.

items.name: citation-result
items.title: Citation Result
items.description: Single source-backed citation card. Claim on top, source attribution below, optional supporting quote and confidence. Verify, reject, or can't tell; undo.

items.name: editable-plan
items.title: Editable Plan
items.description: Multi-step plan the human can reorder, rename, add to, or delete from before the agent executes. Locked steps cannot be removed. Submit or cancel; undo.

items.name: tool-call-preview
items.title: Tool Call Preview
items.description: Preview a tool call (name, args, optional rationale and signals) so the human can approve, reject, or say they can't tell before execution. External scopes are flagged. Pairs with the gates layer.

items.name: evidence-pointer
items.title: Evidence Pointer
items.description: Where a claim is grounded, not merely that it is. One row per pointer with source, locator in human units, and excerpt; sources consulted but not drawn from are listed so silence never reads as safety. Grounded, not supported, or can't tell; undo.
